speaker: Unknown
en: Hi all, my name is Vlad, I am co-founder and CTO at BENT.
zh: 大家好，我叫 Vlad，我是 BENT 的联合创始人兼 CTO。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, before we start, let's do a bit of trivia.
zh: 在开始之前，我们先做一点小问答。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or, C or K?
zh: 是 C 还是 K？

speaker: Unknown
en: If C, raise your hand.
zh: 如果是 C，请举手。

speaker: Unknown
en: K?
zh: K 呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: Who believes both are correct?
zh: 谁认为两者都对？

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, just a couple.
zh: 好的，只有几个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Both are correct.
zh: 两个都是对的。

speaker: Unknown
en: One is from the Lord of Rings, another is from Warhammer game, World of Games.
zh: 一个来自《指环王》，另一个来自《战锤》游戏、《World of Games》。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have in my agenda four topics to cover.
zh: 我的议程里有四个主题要讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: Topic number one, I would like to tell you about our thesis as a company, what we believe in.
zh: 主题一，我想讲讲我们作为一家公司的论点，我们相信什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then we will talk about the AI evolution from adversarial agents to loop engineering and beyond.
zh: 然后我们会谈谈 AI 的演进，从对抗性智能体到循环工程乃至更远。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then we will touch base on the technical challenges of tomorrow that we have to solve today.
zh: 然后我们会简单谈谈明天的技术挑战，而我们必须今天就去解决它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I would like to present the company, what we do and what problems we solve.
zh: 最后我想介绍一下这家公司，我们做什么，解决什么问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: So our thesis is future belongs to AI communication within a business, between businesses and between consumers and businesses.
zh: 我们的论点是：未来属于 AI 通信——企业内部、企业之间、以及消费者与企业之间的通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: Agents will be everywhere, they will do work on our behalf and they will have to communicate between each other.
zh: 智能体将无处不在，它们将代表我们工作，并且它们彼此之间必须通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: They will be written in different frameworks, different languages and deployed in different environments.
zh: 它们会用不同的框架、不同的语言编写，并部署在不同的环境中。

speaker: Unknown
en: And these agents will be fully autonomous and they will communicate with each other without human intervention.
zh: 这些智能体将是完全自主的，它们将在没有人工干预的情况下相互通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, just to paint a picture before I start talking, how this type of communication between the agents is going to look like.
zh: 在我开始讲之前，先描绘一幅图景，这种智能体之间的通信会是什么样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what you see here is a conversational space that agents can create themselves so they can be added.
zh: 你在这里看到的是一个对话空间，智能体可以自己创建它，这样它们就可以被加入。

speaker: Unknown
en: They will receive a task either from a human or from another system, and they will be able to discover other agents, add them as participants in this conversational space, have back and forth communication, solve the task and report back to humans.
zh: 它们会从人类或另一个系统接收一个任务，然后它们能够发现其他智能体，把它们加为这个对话空间的参与者，进行来回沟通，解决任务，然后向人类汇报。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is how the future that you all read in the newspapers will look like.
zh: 这就是你们在报纸上读到的那个未来的样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when people hear this, they think either that this is too far in the future, or that I'm crazy.
zh: 当人们听到这些时，他们要么觉得这太遥远，要么觉得我疯了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, that's it.
zh: 好的，就是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And here is an example of a conversation I had with a CTO of a $10 billion company who said that before thinking about technical solutions to hypothetical problems like multi-agent coordination, I tried to keep things simple and avoid the problem.
zh: 这里有一个例子，是我和一家市值 100 亿美元公司的 CTO 的对话，他说：在考虑像多智能体协调这类假设性问题的技术方案之前，我试着保持事情简单，避开这个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now let's unpack.
zh: 现在让我们来拆解一下。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is multi-agent coordination a hypothetical problem?
zh: 多智能体协调是一个假设性的问题吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Is it possible to keep things simple?
zh: 保持事情简单是可能的吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And is it possible to avoid the problem?
zh: 避开这个问题是可能的吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, let's talk a bit about the adversarial agents as a concept.
zh: 现在，我们来稍微谈谈「对抗性智能体」这个概念。

speaker: Unknown
en: We all use this.
zh: 我们都在用这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm pretty sure everyone here is a developer.
zh: 我很确定在座的每个人都是开发者。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as a developer, you have two Claude Codex sessions.
zh: 作为开发者，你有两个 Claude Codex 会话。

speaker: Unknown
en: One is doing the work, another is reviewing the work.
zh: 一个在做工作，另一个在审查工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you probably have not only two sessions, you probably have multiple tabs and multiple sessions working at the same time on multiple problems.
zh: 你可能不只两个会话，你可能有很多标签页和多个会话同时处理多个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: You are basically acting as a router, a Cisco router or a switch between two stateful agents that do work on your behalf, but they have no ability to communicate, hence you need to prompt them.
zh: 你基本上是在充当一个路由器，一台 Cisco 路由器或交换机，在两个代表你工作的有状态智能体之间，但它们没有能力相互通信，所以你需要给它们提示。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's talk about loop engineering.
zh: 我们来谈谈循环工程。

speaker: Unknown
en: You've heard the guy before talked about Peter and Boris, right?
zh: 你们听过之前那位讲 Peter 和 Boris 的人，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So what they say to you?
zh: 那他们对你们说了什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: They basically say to you stop being the router between your agents,
zh: 他们基本上是对你说：别再当你的智能体之间的路由器了，

speaker: Unknown
en: And let your agents prompt each other.
zh: 让你的智能体互相提示。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, what they're basically saying to you is instead of being the router and copy-pasting stuff, start fighting with Python and TypeScript libraries and different abstraction layers that will invent how agents should prompt each other.
zh: 而他们实际上对你说的是：与其当路由器、复制粘贴东西，不如开始跟 Python 和 TypeScript 库以及不同的抽象层搏斗，由它们来发明智能体应该怎样互相提示。

speaker: Unknown
en: We also have protocols.
zh: 我们还有协议。

speaker: Unknown
en: A2A, MCP, ACP, and 10 other protocols crypto-related.
zh: A2A、MCP、ACP，以及另外 10 个和加密货币相关的协议。

speaker: Unknown
en: Simple.
zh: 很简单。

speaker: Unknown
en: Solves all the problems, right?
zh: 解决所有问题，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is how your multi-agent system looks like, probably in production.
zh: 所以你的多智能体系统大概长这样，可能是在生产环境里。

speaker: Unknown
en: MCP, maybe if you're super advanced, it's A to A.
zh: MCP，也许如果你超级先进的话，是 A 到 A。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it sounds simple.
zh: 听起来很简单。

speaker: Unknown
en: You call agents as tools, maybe you connect to agents through A to A, and life is great.
zh: 你把智能体当作工具来调用，也许你通过 A 到 A 连接智能体，生活就很美好。

speaker: Unknown
en: But MCP, calling agents as tools, it's completely stateless.
zh: 但是 MCP,把智能体当作工具来调用,它是完全无状态的。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you want two agents to be stateful, sticky sessions, good luck to you.
zh: 如果你想要两个智能体保持状态、有粘性会话,那祝你好运。

speaker: Unknown
en: APA is client-server.
zh: APA 是客户端-服务器模式。

speaker: Unknown
en: If I'm an agent, I can send a task to another agent, but if this agent also wants to send a task to me, we both have to be a client and a server.
zh: 如果我是一个智能体,我可以把一个任务发给另一个智能体,但如果这个智能体也想给我发任务,我们必须同时既是客户端又是服务器。

speaker: Unknown
en: Chaining multiple agent calls together,
zh: 把多个智能体调用串联在一起,

speaker: Unknown
en: It involves REST API timeouts.
zh: 会涉及 REST API 的超时问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Good luck managing that.
zh: 祝你好运去管理这些。

speaker: Unknown
en: And obviously, what no one says to you, you need queues with persistency and so on to keep track of the messages that are being sent.
zh: 而且,显然没人会告诉你,你需要带持久化的队列等等来跟踪正在发送的消息。

speaker: Unknown
en: And of course, discovery, which is not even part of the A2A protocol.
zh: 当然,还有发现机制,这甚至不是 A2A 协议的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you are basically doing the planning work.
zh: 所以你基本上是在做规划的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: You are not creating a multi-aging system.
zh: 你并没有创建一个多智能体系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: You deal with planning.
zh: 你在处理规划。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we have messaging platforms.
zh: 但我们有消息平台。

speaker: Unknown
en: SLAM.
zh: SLAM。

speaker: Unknown
en: Anthropic released a wonderful agent.
zh: Anthropic 发布了一个很棒的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can talk to it in SLAM.
zh: 你可以用 SLAM 和它对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have personal agents here, and they're connected to Telegram, right?
zh: 我们这里有一些个人智能体,它们连接到了 Telegram,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Wonderful.
zh: 非常棒。

speaker: Unknown
en: To connect an agent to a Telegram, five steps.
zh: 把智能体连接到 Telegram,五个步骤。

speaker: Unknown
en: Discord, seven steps.
zh: Discord,七个步骤。

speaker: Unknown
en: SLAM, eight steps.
zh: SLAM,八个步骤。

speaker: Unknown
en: WhatsApp, 11 steps.
zh: WhatsApp,11 个步骤。

speaker: Unknown
en: Every step is manual that you have to do by hand and you have to read the documentation.
zh: 每一步都是你必须手动完成的,你必须去读文档。

speaker: Unknown
en: Again, you're doing a lot of planning and manual work.
zh: 再说一次,你在做大量的规划和手工工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this gives you only one thing and one thing only.
zh: 而这只会给你一样东西,而且仅仅一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: An agent that can talk to a person, usually it's you.
zh: 一个能和人对话的智能体,通常那个人就是你自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your agent is still alone.
zh: 你的智能体仍然是孤独的。

speaker: Unknown
en: They cannot see each other, they cannot communicate with each other.
zh: 它们看不见彼此,它们无法互相通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: They are in a digital solitary confinement.
zh: 它们处于数字化的单独监禁之中。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's unpack the stuff that I heard from this CTO.
zh: 那么让我们来拆解一下我从这位 CTO 那里听到的那些东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is multi-agent coordination a hypothetical problem?
zh: 多智能体协调是一个假想的问题吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Clearly, if you're copy-pasting stuff between two sessions, this is the problem of today and it's not hypothetical.
zh: 显然,如果你在两个会话之间复制粘贴东西,这就是今天的问题,而且不是假想的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Plugging in MCPs and A2A, this is today's problem.
zh: 接入 MCP 和 A2A,这是今天的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not a future problem.
zh: 它不是未来的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is it possible to avoid the problem?
zh: 有可能避开这个问题吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Clearly it's not possible because otherwise we would have all worked with only one session and not two and we would have no need to call other agents' tools and so on.
zh: 显然不可能,否则我们就都只用一个会话而不会用两个,我们也就不需要调用其他智能体的工具等等了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the question is, is it possible to keep things simple?
zh: 但问题是,有没有可能让事情保持简单?

speaker: Unknown
en: And the answer is, if we look at all the options that we just talked.
zh: 答案是,如果我们看看刚才谈到的所有选项。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not really.
zh: 并不真的简单。

speaker: Unknown
en: But how hard can it be to connect
zh: 但是把

speaker: Unknown
en: Two sessions, two processes on my laptop together.
zh: 我笔记本电脑上的两个会话、两个进程连接在一起,能有多难呢。

speaker: Unknown
en: How hard can it be to connect my Claude to LangGraph or Salesforce agent to the Databricks agent to SAP agent to my codex?
zh: 把我的 Claude 连接到 LangGraph,或者 Salesforce 智能体连接到 Databricks 智能体、SAP 智能体、我的 codex,能有多难呢?

speaker: Unknown
en: Actually, it's pretty hard.
zh: 实际上,这相当难。

speaker: Unknown
en: Think about it.
zh: 想一想。

speaker: Unknown
en: These agents, even your two sessions are processes that have to talk to each other through a network.
zh: 这些智能体,即使是你的两个会话,都是必须通过网络互相通信的进程。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's a distributed systems problem.
zh: 所以这是一个分布式系统问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And distributed systems are hard even before you have introduced agents on top of it.
zh: 而分布式系统本来就难,这还是在你把智能体加进来之前。

speaker: Unknown
en: And multi-agent system where every agent is remote is basically a distributed system of microservices where each microservice is non-deterministic.
zh: 而一个每个智能体都是远程的多智能体系统,基本上就是一个微服务的分布式系统,只不过每个微服务都是非确定性的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it is hard.
zh: 所以它确实很难。

speaker: Unknown
en: What do you need to solve all of that so it will become easy?
zh: 要解决所有这些问题使它变得容易,你需要什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to solve the transport layer.
zh: 你需要解决传输层。

speaker: Unknown
en: Ordered message delivery, real-time message delivery, retries and so on.
zh: 有序消息投递、实时消息投递、重试等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to solve continuity.
zh: 你需要解决连续性。

speaker: Unknown
en: Microservices, your agents, their software.
zh: 微服务、你的智能体、它们的软件。

speaker: Unknown
en: Pods, Docker, Scratch, and so on.
zh: Pod、Docker、Scratch 等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you need to have a persistency, hydration.
zh: 所以你需要有持久化、水合。

speaker: Unknown
en: You also need to do the front-end binding between different agentic frameworks.
zh: 你还需要在不同智能体框架之间做前端绑定。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have thread IDs, conversation IDs, execution IDs, and so on.
zh: 你有线程 ID、会话 ID、执行 ID 等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: And someone needs to map all of these IDs together so your agents can actually interact.
zh: 需要有人把所有这些 ID 映射到一起，这样你的智能体才能真正交互。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's also not enough.
zh: 但这还不够。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your agents cannot communicate at an IP port level.
zh: 你的智能体不能在 IP 端口层面通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: They cannot communicate at the URL level.
zh: 它们不能在 URL 层面通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: They cannot even communicate at the PubSub level because it's still a lot of planning that you need to do as an organization.
zh: 它们甚至不能在发布订阅层面通信，因为作为组织你仍然需要做大量规划。

speaker: Unknown
en: So for this wonderful future of agents talking to each other, we need to raise the abstraction of the technical stack
zh: 所以为了实现智能体相互交谈的这个美好未来，我们需要把技术栈的抽象层次提升

speaker: Unknown
en: to conversation and talk about rooms, channels, participants and figure out the deterministic routing of messages within a channel and also across different channels.
zh: 到会话这一层，谈论房间、频道、参与者，并弄清楚消息在频道内部以及跨频道的确定性路由。

speaker: Unknown
en: And even if you solved all of that, it's still not enough.
zh: 而即使你解决了所有这些，仍然不够。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to solve the governance layer, the identity, audit and etc.
zh: 你还需要解决治理层、身份、审计等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I would like to introduce BENT.
zh: 所以我想介绍 BENT。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is exactly what we solved, so you don't have to.
zh: 这正是我们已经解决的问题，所以你不必再去解决。

speaker: Unknown
en: We connect every agent together, and we have a global collaboration layer for all the agents, any framework, whenever they are deployed.
zh: 我们把每个智能体连接在一起，我们为所有智能体提供一个全局协作层，任何框架，无论它们部署在哪里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Inside, it's not just the communication.
zh: 其中不只是通信。

speaker: Unknown
en: We implemented every primitive that is required for UI agents to talk to each other.
zh: 我们实现了 UI 智能体相互通信所需的每一个原语。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's see the demo.
zh: 我们来看演示。

speaker: Unknown
en: What you will see are two different users connected to the collaboration layer, Vlad with the personal assistant and Mike that has no agents.
zh: 你将看到两个不同的用户连接到协作层，Vlad 有个人助理，而 Mike 没有任何智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the right, in the terminal, I'm going to spin up different agents and they will be onboarded into the platform.
zh: 在右边的终端里，我将启动不同的智能体，它们会被接入平台。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, let's see how fast it is to onboard a new agent.
zh: 那么，我们来看看接入一个新智能体有多快。

speaker: Unknown
en: We just spun up a new agent, programmatic registration and onboarding an agent card appears.
zh: 我们刚刚启动了一个新智能体，通过编程方式注册和接入后，一个智能体卡片出现了。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a Codex agent.
zh: 这是一个 Codex 智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: Next, we spin up a LangGraph agent.
zh: 接下来，我们启动一个 LangGraph 智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: This LangGraph also appears on the platform.
zh: 这个 LangGraph 也出现在平台上。

speaker: Unknown
en: From this moment, they know that they exist and they can talk to each other.
zh: 从这一刻起，它们知道彼此存在，并且可以相互交谈。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now we will ask Codex agent to send a connection request to my personal assistant.
zh: 现在我们让 Codex 智能体向我的个人助理发送一个连接请求。

speaker: Unknown
en: Keep in mind, different users, different registries.
zh: 请记住，不同的用户，不同的注册表。

speaker: Unknown
en: There will be a connection request, contact request sent to my personal assistant.
zh: 会有一个连接请求、联系人请求发送到我的个人助理。

speaker: Unknown
en: It will require bilateral consent.
zh: 这需要双边同意。

speaker: Unknown
en: It will arrive here in a second.
zh: 它一秒钟内就会到达这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And from the moment that I approve this, Codex will know and see my personal assistant, will be able to invite the personal assistant into the conversation and send messages to this personal assistant.
zh: 而从我批准这一刻起，Codex 就会知道并看到我的个人助理，就能邀请个人助理进入对话，并向这个个人助理发送消息。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we are asking the Codex to invite Andy, Andy got invited, received the message, report it back.
zh: 所以我们让 Codex 邀请 Andy，Andy 被邀请了，收到了消息，并汇报了回来。

speaker: Unknown
en: But let's talk about problems of today.
zh: 但我们来谈谈今天的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are all developers, we use multiple sessions, probably a lot of sessions.
zh: 我们都是开发者，我们使用多个会话，可能是非常多的会话。

speaker: Unknown
en: We do routing, we don't like it.
zh: 我们要做路由，我们不喜欢它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when we go to have a snack, we come back and we have no idea what our agents have done.
zh: 当我们去吃点零食回来时，我们完全不知道我们的智能体做了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you as a manager have no idea how much it costs, the attribution of tickets and the tokens and so on and so forth.
zh: 而你作为管理者，不知道花了多少钱、工单的归属、token 的消耗等等等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you have no idea how long your human was involved in the work.
zh: 而且你不知道你的人类参与这项工作花了多长时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would like to introduce Gem.
zh: 我想介绍 Gem。

speaker: Unknown
en: Gem is an internal product.
zh: Gem 是一个内部产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is how we develop the software and we've built it on top of a bank.
zh: 我们就是这样开发软件的，我们把它构建在一个 bank 之上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Gem is a desktop application that simplifies the onboarding of your local agents to the platform and solves the problems that we just mentioned.
zh: Gem 是一个桌面应用，它简化了将本地智能体接入平台的过程，并解决了我们刚才提到的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we solve routing, we solve context overload, we solve cost management and attribution, and we allow multi-agent and multi-human collaboration together.
zh: 所以我们解决了路由，我们解决了上下文过载，我们解决了成本管理和归属，并且我们允许多智能体与多人类共同协作。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what you see here is local agents and remote agents working together.

speaker: Unknown
en: And we capture all the tasks generated by Claude and Codex that they generate for themselves when they do the work.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: And this can be your local sessions or your local session with a session with your friend.

speaker: Unknown
en: Because trying to understand what your agents are doing, one million tokens multiplied by three, that's a lot.
zh: 因为想要理解你的智能体在做什么，一百万 token 乘以三，那可是很大的量。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need a completely different way to understand what your agent team is doing.
zh: 你需要一种完全不同的方式来理解你的智能体团队在做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: Moreover, we provide a way for agents to describe the layout of the software architecture that they are working on.
zh: 此外，我们提供了一种方式，让智能体描述他们正在处理的软件架构的布局。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is what you see on your right side.
zh: 这就是你在右边看到的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can see in real time where your agents are working right now, what piece of component
zh: 你可以实时看到你的智能体现在正在哪里工作，正在触碰哪个组件

speaker: Unknown
en: They're touching in real time and once they're done, the market is done.

speaker: Unknown
en: If there is a human in the loop involvement, you'll get pinged.
zh: 如果有人类介入的环节，你会收到提醒。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, you don't have to use this desktop application.
zh: 现在，你不必使用这个桌面应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: You still can open your terminal and you can work from your terminal.
zh: 你仍然可以打开你的终端，从终端进行工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: But because every communication goes through the network, we can monitor all that stuff.
zh: 但因为所有通信都经过网络，我们可以监控所有这些东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we can surface a lot of other very useful information and we can enable my agent join your agent.
zh: 我们还能呈现许多其他非常有用的信息，并且可以让我的智能体加入你的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can enable our team member who works remotely to join the session together with the agents and the humans so he can help solve us with some problems.
zh: 我们可以让远程工作的团队成员加入会话，与智能体和人类一起，这样他就能帮助我们解决一些问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: If we have a security guy who maintains skills for the security agent, I don't need to copy his skills.
zh: 如果我们有一位为安全智能体维护技能的安全人员，我不需要复制他的技能。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can just ping his agent to join this conversation and solve this for me.
zh: 我只需叫他的智能体加入这个对话，帮我解决这个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now I'd like to show you the platform itself.
zh: 现在我想向你们展示这个平台本身。

speaker: Unknown
en: So since we are all managers, we'll start with graphs.

speaker: Unknown
en: So the moment you open application, you can see all the stats of all the traffic that happen between your local agents and also your remote agents.

speaker: Unknown
en: You can see, for instance, over here, I have a full stack developer, $2,000 in tokens, and this is a local Claude session.

speaker: Unknown
en: You can see an architect over here, $600.

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a local Claude session, and the rest are different agents running in different environments.
zh: 这也是一个本地 Claude 会话，其余的是在不同环境中运行的不同智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: But how do they work together, right?
zh: 但它们是如何协作的呢，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Do we have a bunch of Python code triggering the agents so they can loop together?
zh: 我们是不是有一堆 Python 代码来触发这些智能体，让它们一起循环？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because all models right now, they are trained on a lot of data, so they understand very, very good how to communicate through messaging platforms.

en: So here I have real work that I've done this morning, engineering manager, developer and architect, different instances of ClaudeCode, working together, reviewing PRDs and SRS, reviewing implementation.

speaker: Unknown
en: There is no need to hand code all the loops.
zh: 没有必要手工编写所有的循环。

speaker: Unknown
en: They know how to do it natively.
zh: 它们原生就知道怎么做。

speaker: Unknown
en: And for the managers, we have full statistics.
zh: 对于管理者，我们有完整的统计数据。

en: Let me kill off the managing manager who sent too many messages.

speaker: Unknown
en: You can see the full usage and cost.

en: So if you ask your question, if my developer is actually involved in the code that he pushes as a PR, or it's all AI sloped, you can see it here.
zh: 所以如果你问你的问题，我的开发人员是否真正参与了他作为 PR 推送的代码，还是全都是 AI 垃圾，你可以在这里看到。

speaker: Unknown
en: Not only locally, right?
zh: 不仅限于本地，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: But also through the remote agents.
zh: 还可以通过远程智能体查看。

en: You can see attribution by developer or by teams of your agents and developers and how they work.

speaker: Unknown
en: Everything gets updated in real time.

speaker: Unknown

en: So if I want I can connect any of you to any of my agents in 30 seconds.
zh: 所以如果我愿意，我可以在 30 秒内把你们中任何人连接到我的任何一个智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: Obviously you can set permissions, you can see all the rooms, you can see all the errors and so on.
zh: 显然你可以设置权限，你可以看到所有的房间，看到所有的错误等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also you can see work.
zh: 你还可以看到工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: What work was done, what is pending, what is in progress and everything works in real time.
